c1.evidence: Referrer earns $100 reward bonus per qualifying individual referred to First Heritage FCU who registers for the offer, opens a new APEX Rewards Checking Account, and completes offer requirements within the time specified.

c2.evidence: Official URL on the institution's own domain.

c3.evidence: The refer-a-friend program is separate from the new-member APEX checking bonus (already covered under R2116): this covers the referrer-side payout, not the new member's signup bonus.

c4.evidence: No sign-up fee or purchase required for the referrer; ReferLive is only the registration platform, not a paid service.

s1.note: Referrer registers for the program and shares the offer with friends, family, or coworkers via the link provided in the referral email or on social media.

s2.note: The referred person must register, open a new First Heritage APEX Rewards Checking Account, and within 60 days of account opening complete: at least one direct deposit AND at least twelve debit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions) AND enroll in eStatements.

s3.note: Referrer may receive up to five reward bonuses ($500 value) within a calendar year; only one referrer may receive a bonus for each referred person.

s4.note: Reward delivery timeframe: allow 30 days after completing all offer requirements. Reward bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS. Offer can be changed or revoked at any time. Federally insured by NCUA.

s5.note: Estimated 5-15 minutes of active time to register and share the referral link.

s6.note: Offer is ongoing on the official page (checked 2026-09-23); terms state the offer can be changed at any time without notice.

s7.note: Reward bonuses may be reported to the IRS as income.
